UK orders may arrive in multiple deliveries if items ship from different locations. International orders are sent DDP, with all taxes and duties calculated and paid at checkout—no additional charges on delivery.
Orders placed before 11am (Mon–Fri) are usually shipped the same day, though delays may occur during peak periods. Orders after 11am ship the next working day. Shipping runs Monday–Friday only (excluding UK bank holidays), with no weekend dispatch. Tracking details are emailed once shipped. For delivery queries, contact web@universalworks.co.uk, live chat, or phone.
Delivery Within the UK.: What shipping rates do you offer?
Free Standard Shipping on UK Orders Over £50.: Uk standard shipping - 2-3 working days from dispatch - £3.95.

Returns for refunds or exchanges are accepted within 30 days of delivery. Returns received after this period are not eligible for a refund.
Please ensure that you return your unworn goods as sold, in their original packaging, including all labels and tags. Please ensure that if you are purchasing footwear, it is returned in its original packaging, e.g. any paper, inserts and original box. Please also ensure that footwear is returned in its original packaging/box, and do not affix returns labels directly to the shoe box.
Please go to the returns portal and follow the instructions. Please keep note of your order number—this will be on your initial confirmation email.
Return window.
As standard, our returns policy is 30 days from when you receive your item. Returns received 30 days after the receipt of your order, will not qualify for a refund. During Sale periods, we do not accept exchanges. Please return your original order and place a new order for the replacement.

Hopefully you can find the answers to some of our most frequently asked questions below. If there is a question below that is not answered, or if you have another issue, then please contact us directly and send an e-mail to web@universalworks.com, or via live chat or by phone. You can find our contact information here.
Account Information.
Do I need to create an account to place an order?
No you can check out as a guest. However creating an account will speed up the process on subsequent visits if you log into your account before placing another order.

Please click the link underneath where you sign in and we will send you a new password.

about.sum:
Universal Works produce contemporary clothing for all.
The company's first collection launched in 2009 with David Keyte (UW co-founder, director, designer) working from his kitchen table with an aim to make real, honest clothing based on fit and good design, though never over designed.
Universal Works was inspired by David’s formative years growing up in a provincial Midlands' town in the seventies, part of a working-class family that loved to dress well, seeing his Dad and Uncles in their workwear and also when dressing for the weekend. Next, working as a sign-writers apprentice, whilst experiencing the development of eighties sporting and music subcultures. And finally, a thirty-year span in the fashion industry. From Paul Smith to Maharishi, David gained an education from, and worked alongside some of the best in the industry.
With David’s life work reading like a description of the company's DNA, Universal Works is about the mixing of ideas; understanding heritage and context, underpinned by contemporary needs and aesthetics.
